entities.name: Network
entities.description: Entity that initiates EMM common procedures based on received information such as IMSI, GUTI, and KSI.

entities.name: Identification procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for identifying the UE.

entities.name: Authentication procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for authenticating the UE.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: EMM common procedure for establishing security mode.

entities.name: International Mobile Subscriber Identity
entities.description: Unique identifier for a mobile subscriber.

entities.name: Globally Unique Temporary Identity
entities.description: Temporary identifier assigned to the UE by the network.

entities.name: Key Set Identifier
entities.description: Identifier for the security key set used in authentication and security procedures.

relations.description: Network initiates the identification procedure as part of EMM common procedures.
Network initiates the authentication procedure as part of EMM common procedures.
Network initiates the security mode control procedure as part of EMM common procedures.
Network uses IMSI as received information to determine initiation of EMM common procedures.
Network uses GUTI as received information to determine initiation of EMM common procedures.
Network uses KSI as received information to determine initiation of EMM common procedures.
